rules: The coverage break is above 168 days, not at 126: DELAY($close, 252) failed at 0.872 even though it is a price field, alongside four 252-day fundamental normalisers (0.824-0.882) and a 126-day delta of a fundamental ratio (0.882). Price extrema at 126 days and a 168-day TS_RANK($close) both sat inside accepts, so treat 252 as the hard ceiling on any lookback and 126 as still safe on OHLC.

Normalising a fundamental by a long-window TS statistic of itself went 0 for 4, all on coverage: TS_STD($roa,252), TS_STD($roe,252), TS_MEAN(ABS($accrual_gap),252) and TS_MAX($asset_turnover,252). Scale a fundamental with a price- or volume-derived series instead; every accept that scaled one did.

Swapping $roa for $roe is not a decorrelating edit: the same spread times the same TS_CORR leg came back at rho 0.859 with only that field changed. Move to a different accounting dimension ($asset_turnover, $accrual_gap, $operating_margin) when the archived parent already uses one of the profitability pair.

archive_subtree keys on the price/volume leg, so a fresh fundamental leg does not rescue a stale one: two proposals led by $operating_margin * $asset_turnover, a product that appears nowhere in the archive, still shared 5 nodes through their price legs. Spend the novelty budget on the price/volume subtree.

Rearranging the operators around two legs does not move rho. MIN(fundamental rank, 1 - price rank) hit 0.806 against the product of the same pair; a fundamental divided by TS_STD($return,42) hit 0.817 against the same rank times a range ratio; and two simultaneous function swaps inside one price leg (TS_MIN to TS_MEAN in the numerator, TS_MEAN to TS_STD in the denominator) still held at 0.833. Change a field or a window, not the functions wrapped around them.

Two legs beat three, on both gates. Bolting a third gated term onto an archived roe-minus-TS_CORR expression still scored rho 0.848, and the one accept whose price leg used three operators over two windows came in at fitness 1.366 while every two-leg accept scored 2.6 to 5.6.

Fundamental acceleration is noise: a 63-day delta minus its own 63-day lag screened at |t| 0.68. The single 63-day TS_DELTA($roa) with no second differencing carried the round's second-best accept at 4.490.

TS_RANK of a price series belongs on the multiplicative side, not in a rank spread. Subtracted from a fundamental rank at 42 days it screened at |t| 0.63; multiplied against a fundamental z-score at 168 days it scored 4.490.
